headline: Artem Goncharov jumps to 55th on ARC-3

sections.text: Artem Goncharov gained 2.84 points to reach 34.11, moving from 335th to 55th on the ARC-3 public board.
The climb puts Goncharov inside the board’s top 100.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
